initial.title: [v0.92.1][V3-A] C-SDLC v3 contract and construction decision
initial.goal: Produce one reviewed C-SDLC v3 contract and construction-decision packet.
initial.required_outcome: A reviewable versioned contract, exact predecessor-coverage matrix, construction decision, and rollback posture for requirements #161 through #163, while C-SDLC v2 remains sole operational authority.
authority_boundary: C-SDLC v2 remains the sole operational lifecycle authority throughout #500.
Issue completion is exactly acceptance of one v3 contract and construction decision.
No authority cutover, v2 retirement, or later V3 implementation is authorized.
operator_constraints: Do not bind or execute during readiness preparation.
Do not modify C-SDLC v2 behavior or authority.
Do not touch other Sprint 5 issues or unrelated issue records.
initial.task_boundary: Define and review only the V3-A contract and construction-decision packet, including exact retained-requirement mapping and rollback posture.
deliverables: Versioned C-SDLC v3 contract under docs/csdlc-v3/**
Exact predecessor coverage matrix for #161, #162, and #163
Reviewable construction and rollback decision packet
Minimal non-authoritative csdlc-v3 crate contract boundary
Focused validation and exact-head review evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The v3 authority boundary and compatibility posture are explicit.
AC-2: Requirements 161 through 163 are mapped exactly.
AC-3: Construction and rollback decisions are reviewable.
dependencies: None; #161, #162, and #163 are retained predecessor inputs, not open execution blockers.
non_goals: Implementation of V3-B or later issues
initial.plan_summary: Inventory retained predecessor requirements, define the versioned v3 contract and construction decisions, specify rollback and coexistence boundaries, then obtain focused validation and exact-head review.

steps.action: Inventory and normalize every retained requirement and decision from #161 through #163.
Write the versioned v3 contract and explicit v2 coexistence and compatibility boundary.
Record construction and rollback decisions and the minimal non-authoritative crate boundary.
Run all focused PVF lanes and obtain independent exact-head review.

invariants: C-SDLC v2 remains sole operational authority.
Every retained requirement from #161 through #163 has exactly one explicit disposition.
The construction packet does not silently implement or authorize later V3 work.
Rollback and unsupported-platform behavior fail closed.
risks: A retained predecessor requirement is omitted or duplicated.
Compatibility language silently grants v3 authority.
Construction decisions drift from measured #162 or approved #163 evidence.
Minimal crate work widens into implementation.
stop_conditions: The v2 coexistence boundary is ambiguous.
Construction requires authority cutover or v2 retirement.
Work expands into V3-B or later implementation.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate the versioned v3 contract shape and mandatory authority, compatibility, construction, and rollback clauses.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Runs after the contract and minimal crate boundary are implemented.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact, non-duplicated disposition coverage for retained requirements #161 through #163.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Runs after the predecessor coverage matrix is implemented.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Reject ambiguous coexistence, v2 authority changes, and construction decisions outside the declared V3-A boundary.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Runs after the contract boundary is implemented.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Reject whitespace and malformed diff defects in the bounded issue diff.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on ambiguous v2 coexistence, missing or duplicated predecessor coverage, unreviewable rollback, undeclared scope, or any implied authority cutover.
review_prompts: Does every retained requirement from #161 through #163 have exactly one traceable disposition?
Can any contract clause be read as granting v3 operational authority before V3-F?
Are construction and rollback decisions grounded in #162 measurements and #163 operator approval?
Does the minimal crate surface stay non-authoritative and inside V3-A?
initial.review_scope: V3-A contract, predecessor mapping, construction and rollback decisions, v2 coexistence boundary, and declared owned paths only.
